title: rideshare-qc report.json
description: The machine-readable QC report written by `rideshare-qc run`. schema_version changes when a field is removed or changes meaning.

input_name.description: Base name of the input; never a full path.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file that was passed: the CSV, or the archive.

input_size_bytes.description: Size of the file that was passed.

bom.description: The CSV that was read (the archive's member, for an archive) starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark.

member.description: The CSV extracted from an archive input; null for a CSV input.

name.description: Base name of the member inside the archive.

window.description: Earliest and latest email_time as naive ISO 8601 timestamps: no UTC offset is written, although email_time is assumed to be UTC. Null for a file with no rows.

blank_lines.description: Empty lines of the CSV that was read. They are dropped on reading, not an error.

cache.description: Whether the typed frame came from the Parquet cache (hit), was read and then cached (miss), or no cache was configured (off).

config.description: The effective configuration, after the TOML file and CLI flags.

checks.description: Effective threshold and severity of every check that ran.

metric.description: The measured value (the failure rate for a row rule); null when nothing was evaluated.

threshold.description: The most the metric may be for the check to pass; null for checks without one.

predicate.description: The rule a good row or dataset satisfies, in words.

details.description: Check-specific facts, e.g. the column names an info check found.

sample_file.description: Path of the failing-row sample, relative to the report directory; null when none was written.

composition.description: Receipts by merchant and receipt kind; present when the receipt_kinds check ran.

merchants.description: Merchant names, sorted; the keys of every by_merchant.

kinds.description: Every receipt kind, in canonical order (zero counts included).

rider_spend.description: Counts toward rider spend (ride, tip_update, fare_correction, cancel_noshow).

spend.description: The spend waterfall; present when the currency_suspect_rows check ran. Rows are counted and amounts summed over receipts with an order_total_amount. clean_usd_rider_spend = naive_total - currency_suspect - non_rider_spend - superseded; each row is in exactly one of the last four groups. No FX conversion is applied.

micromobility.description: Bikes and scooters: the part of non_rider_spend that is micromobility (excluded; not rider spend). A sub-line, not a further deduction.

note.description: The currency caveat on the suspect amounts.

outputs.description: The files this run wrote into the output directory. The directory may also hold files from other runs; only these belong to this report.

parquet.description: File name of the curated Parquet, relative to the report directory (the same as curated.name).

curated.description: The curated Parquet: every input row (none is dropped; dedupe is the is_superseded flag) with the typed input columns, the derived columns and the per-row QC flags. Null when none was written.

name.description: File name, relative to the report directory.

rows.description: Rows written; equal to the input's row count.

samples.description: Sample files written by this run, relative to the report directory.

exit_code.description: The exit status of the run (2 and 3 are never written: input errors and internal errors produce no report).

amount.description: Sum of order_total_amount, rounded to cents.
